title: Guides
description: Learn how to build, review, and adapt a repeatable setup from the files and modules in your blueprint.

sections.title: Build your setup
paragraphs: Start by understanding where configuration lives and how the installer resolves module implementations. These guides take you from a blueprint fork to a small, reviewed setup you can verify on one machine.

sections.title: Customize the pieces
paragraphs: Bring your own dotfiles, add a focused module, and separate the responsibilities of your machines. Keep preferences and platform differences explicit so you can review them before the next installation.

sections.title: Adapt an existing setup
paragraphs: Recheck coverage when changing adapters or moving to a new host. A versioned blueprint makes your intent portable; the new environment still needs its own compatibility and acceptance checks.
